run_parallel_sample: run the parallel_sample function with a question and n fork count to generate multiple responses
create_sgl_function: create an sgl function decorated with @sgl.function that defines a stateful LLM prompt template
fork_parallel_states: fork an sgl state into n parallel branches using s.fork(n) to generate multiple outputs
join_forked_states: join forked parallel branches back into a single state using forks.join()
generate_text_with_options: generate text with sgl.gen using stop sequences or choice constraints for controlled output
